message: Interesting posts--thanks for the links to the NYT articles.  I appreciate the inclusion of the Dead Kennedys in this pseduo-assignment.  The entire "Fresh Fruit..." album speaks to the intersection of consumerism and civic responsibility.  Brilliant, brilliant record.  I've used "Kill the Poor" and "Let's Lynch the Landlord" in class to talk about representations of class...the latter especially provoked a nice discussion of the uses and ethics of various punk iconography (Nazi images, "lynching" as resistance?!, etc.).  But my fave track--Jello's social commentary aside--has always been "Stealing People's Mail," which I can't listen to without laughing out loud.
